## bijection_verdict

**PASS.** No KB-BIJECTION RED for task 1. First revision.

Policy-side note (not a KB verdict): the settlement takes off every credit posted in the settlement period, including the dispensing-delay credit on an order whose own charges are not yet past due under the two-month waiting period. The source states exactly this (`pd_credits`; edge `effect`), and the documents carry it faithfully.
